q: The ____ is the unit used for measuring sound intensity. (2024)
c: decibel (dB) or watt per metre squared (Wm⁻²)
e: Sound intensity level is measured in decibels (dB) or watts per metre squared (Wm⁻²).

q: The SI unit of sound intensity is the ____ per square metre. (2025)
e: The SI unit of sound intensity is watt per square metre.

q: The speed of sound is ____ in solids than liquids and gases. (2024)
e: Sound travels faster in solids because particles are closely packed together.

q: An echo is repetition of sound due to the ____ of sound. (2024)
e: An echo is produced when sound waves reflect off a barrier back to the source.

q: The ____ is the unit used for measuring sound intensity. (2025)
e: The decibel (dB) is a unit used to measure sound intensity level.

q: The ____ of the note is determined by its frequency. (2026)
e: Pitch is the property of sound that depends directly on frequency.

q: An ____ is repetition of sound due to the reflection of sound. (2025)
e: An echo occurs when sound is reflected back from a surface.

q: ____ is the special ability of emitting sounds and interpreting the echoes. (2025)
e: Echolocation allows certain animals to navigate and locate objects using sound reflection.

q: An ____ is repetition of sound due to the reflection of sound. (2025)
e: An echo is caused by the reflection of sound waves off a surface.

q: The range of frequencies a person can hear is known as the ____. (2025)
e: The range of frequencies audible to human ears is known as the range of audibility.

q: The loudness of the note depends upon the ____ of the wave that produces it. (2025)
e: Loudness increases as the amplitude of the sound wave increases.

q: The number of vibrations per second, which determines the pitch of sound, is called the ____ of sound. (2025)
e: Frequency is defined as the number of complete vibrations per second.

q: Bats and whales use ultrasound in ____. (2025)
e: Bats and whales emit ultrasound waves for echolocation to navigate and locate objects.

q: The greater the frequency, the ____ is the pitch. (2025)
e: Sound waves with higher frequencies are perceived as having a higher pitch.

q: The speed of sound is ____ in solids than liquids and gases. (2025)
e: Sound travels faster in solids due to higher elasticity and density.

q: The pitch of the note (how high it is) is determined by its ____. (2025)
e: The frequency of a sound wave determines how high or low its pitch sounds.

q: Young's modules and the bulk modulus are ____ properties of the medium. (2025)
e: Young's modulus and bulk modulus are elastic constants that describe medium elasticity.

q: By using ____, the audible frequency range can be determined. (2025)
e: A frequency generator can produce audio signals to test human hearing limits.

q: The sonar is a type of technology that works based on ____. (2026)
e: SONAR technology uses sound echoes to measure distances underwater.

q: The SI units of Young's modulus and the bulk modulus are ____. (2026)
e: Elastic moduli are measured in newtons per square metre (Nm⁻²).

q: The pitch of a sound is determined by its ____. (2026)
e: Frequency determines the pitch of a sound wave.

q: Bats and dolphins use ____ in echolocations. (2026)
e: Bats and dolphins utilize high-frequency ultrasound waves for echolocation.
